wiki.title: Stephen M. Ross (politician)
wiki.extract: Stephen Miles Ross (born 1951) is an American politician. He was elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2012, and he served from 2013 until 2021. He was reelected in 2022 after a rematch with Ricky Hurtado, who previously had defeated Ross in 2020. A Republican, he serves the 63rd district. He has also served as mayor of Burlington, North Carolina.
